# What discrete steps and whole amounts represent

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`what-discrete-steps-and-whole-amounts-represent` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](what-discrete-steps-and-whole-amounts-represent.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Discrete steps represent real-valued time exactly for balance; whole amounts are not available where amounts change ever less; over real amounts novelty needs gain only by a least separation, and runaway is set by frequency where held, by strength where damped.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A course in real-valued time whose levels change at the rate given less taken, its rates summable, balances over every stretch and across every step of any reading at instants, a coarser reading summing the finer; a balanced course read at the whole instants can stand still at every step and change between them. (`Becoming.Representation.Course`, `Becoming.Representation.Course.Balances`, `Becoming.Representation.Course.balance_over`, `Becoming.Representation.Course.givenOver_coarse`, `Becoming.Representation.Course.sample_balances`, `Becoming.Representation.Course.takenOver_coarse`, `Becoming.Representation.Oscillation.still_reading`)
2. No reading into the whole numbers keeps the strict falls of an amount falling at every step, in any amounts and in the reals; amounts in multiples of a unit are read in whole numbers. (`Becoming.Amounts.no_whole_reading`, `Becoming.Halving.no_whole_reading`, `Becoming.Representation.no_whole_reading`, `Becoming.Representation.reals_no_whole_reading`, `Becoming.Representation.unit_reading`)
3. The halving stock is new at every step without gain; finitely many conditions new by at least a least separation at every step exceed every bound. (`Becoming.Halving.new_without_gain`, `Becoming.Representation.new_without_gain`, `Becoming.Representation.separated_bounded`, `Becoming.Representation.separated_exceeds`)
4. A return of strength one half does not double; a held loop of every positive real strength carries D (1 + r) to the count, the core's self-loop its case, and is bounded by a polynomial exactly where two to the count is; damped, coupling at every step, it stays bounded exactly where its factor and strength add to at most one, and vanishes below. (`Becoming.Dyadic.half_return`, `Becoming.Representation.carried`, `Becoming.Representation.every_bounded_iff`, `Becoming.Representation.every_carried`, `Becoming.Representation.every_vanishes`, `Becoming.Representation.held_carried`, `Becoming.Representation.held_polynomial_iff`, `Becoming.Representation.selfLoop_cast`)
5. A web of several conditions coupled at every step, in any normed ring of steps: what it carries vanishes exactly where its rate (the least norm of a power to the inverse of the power, the spectral radius by Gelfand's formula) is below one, and runs away where above one; one condition's rate is the absolute value of factor plus strength; held and coupling at some steps only, a web carries (1 + S) to the count and, its rate above one, is bounded by a polynomial exactly where two to the count is; damped and coupling at some steps, it carries a to the steps not coupled times (a + S) to the count, vanishes where couplings are rare enough for the damping and runs away where frequent enough against it (XL3). (`Becoming.Representation.dampedWeb`, `Becoming.Representation.dampedWeb_eq`, `Becoming.Representation.dampedWeb_unbounded`, `Becoming.Representation.dampedWeb_vanishes`, `Becoming.Representation.every_vanishes_iff`, `Becoming.Representation.pow_rate_le`, `Becoming.Representation.rate`, `Becoming.Representation.rate_le`, `Becoming.Representation.rate_pow_le_norm`, `Becoming.Representation.rate_real`, `Becoming.Representation.unbounded_of_one_lt`, `Becoming.Representation.vanishes_iff`, `Becoming.Representation.webCarried`, `Becoming.Representation.webCarried_eq`, `Becoming.Representation.web_polynomial_iff`)
6. At rate at most one a web grows slower than every exponential; the rate does not decide whether it stays bounded: the identity is bounded with rate one, the shear (the dual number 1 + ε) carries 1 + n with rate one (XL4). (`Becoming.Representation.rate_nonneg`, `Becoming.Representation.rate_one`, `Becoming.Representation.rate_smul`, `Becoming.Representation.shear`, `Becoming.Representation.shear_pow_norm`, `Becoming.Representation.shear_rate`, `Becoming.Representation.subexponential`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No premise in the core module; the periphery uses Lean's standard axioms through Mathlib and states the summability of rates, the bounds and the strengths where each law takes them.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That an actual becoming's rates are summable, its amounts real, or its loops of one condition.
- That the whole-number laws are wrong where they apply: they hold of every becoming with a least change.
- The gap between the damped laws where a coupled step's norm exceeds its rate; that the rate is the spectral radius (Gelfand's formula, cited).
- **Counterexample:** Halving.new_without_gain against Web.rises_late_of_new over dense amounts; Dyadic.half_return against carried_doubles_roundTrip. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/WholeAmounts.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Oscillation.still_reading: a balanced course still at every whole instant and changing between them. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/representation/Representation.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
